name: Virtual List
description: Renders only the visible slice of a large fixed-height list, keeping thousands of rows scrolling smoothly.

anatomy.description: The fixed-height scroll container that also serves as a keyboard tab stop.
The full-height sizer that keeps the scrollbar honest for the entire item count.
The visible rows plus overscan, each reporting aria-posinset and aria-setsize.

dos: Give the list a label and an explicit pixel height.
Keep row heights fixed; itemHeight is a guarantee, not a hint.
Use the index from renderItem for stable keys.
donts: Don't virtualize short lists; below a few dozen rows plain rendering is cheaper.
Don't expect find-in-page or skip links to reach unmounted rows.
Don't put expanding or variable-height rows inside.

examples.title: Compact roster
examples.description: Five hundred rows scroll instantly because only the viewport window plus overscan is mounted in the DOM.

examples.title: Rich rows
examples.description: renderItem receives the item and index, so rows can mix metadata, avatars, and actions freely.

guidance.useWhen: Lists of hundreds or thousands of equally-sized rows where mounting every row would slow the page down.
guidance.avoidWhen: Short lists, rows of varying height, or content that must be findable with browser find-in-page; use a plain List instead.
guidance.behavior: Guarantees a fixed itemHeight per row, renders overscan rows around the viewport, and reports aria-setsize and aria-posinset for the virtual window.
guidance.responsive: Takes an explicit pixel height; wrap it in a flexible container and compute the height if it must track the viewport.

keyboard.action: Scrolls the list once it has focus.
Moves focus into the scrollable list, which is a tab stop.

notes: Each mounted row exposes aria-posinset and aria-setsize so screen readers announce the true position in the full set.
Rows outside the window are not in the DOM, so skip-links and find-in-page only see the rendered slice.

apiEntries.description: Windowed list renderer that mounts only the rows near the scroll position.

props.description: Height of the scrollable viewport in pixels.
props.name: height

props.description: Items windowed over; only the visible slice is rendered.
props.name: items

props.description: Extra rows rendered above and below the viewport to reduce blank flashes.
props.name: overscan

props.description: Renders one row for the given item.
